about: A modern infantryman's moves. The legs and body: Quaternius' game-made walk, jog and sprint (a man's stride, steady through the hips), crouched idle and walk, an idle; the game puts the arms on the weapon itself (two-bone IK), so these clips' arms are overridden except for the knife, the throw, hits and falls. Whole body: a knife strike, a grenade throw, hit, falling dead, getting up, a combat roll.
